# @ndigo/ai-sdk

AI SDK integration layer for Ndigo: the only package that imports the Vercel AI SDK

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Capabilities

- `agent-model` — Add a bounded, provider-neutral tool-calling loop with streaming, structured output, and telemetry. Packages: `@ndigo/ai`, `@ndigo/ai-sdk`. Guide: `ai-agents`.

## Public exports

- `AISDKModelOptions` *(type)* — Optional identity overrides. Without them the adapter reads `provider` and `modelId` from the AI SDK model and falls back to `ai-sdk`.
- `AISDKModel` — Adapts an AI SDK `LanguageModel` to the provider-neutral `AIModel` contract.
- `aiSdkModel` — Creates an AISDKModel without `new`.
